        - paragraph:

        - paragraph: Current finite secant slope mPQ = 0.7143

    - article:
      - heading "REMEMBER" [level=2]
      - paragraph: • Tangent at P(at²,2at) is ty=x+at².
      - paragraph: • As a secant point approaches P, its slope approaches 1/t.
